A quality Cocktail Bar
Oct 2025 • Couples
If you like a quality cocktail seek out this hidden gem. Trust ‘maps’ and look up for the Alley’s Bar sign which directs you down a narrow alley. Keep going around the right hand corner and the bar is about 20 metres up on the left. The door, (see picture), gives no clue as a dark curtain behind the door hides the bar.
Once inside it’s a different atmosphere. Low light, contemporary bar with a fully stocked back bar. 
The staff were excellent and made cocktails on request or as ordered from the menu. All our cocktails were delicious, really well made. 
So give it a go and find this bar.

Unexpectedly good find
Jul 2023 • Couples
The bar staff were excellent and friendly . We asked for, and they gave us, an in depth history of Vietnam, its language and places to visit ( and not visit at this time of year) in Vietnam as well as suggestions if we ever visit again. Lovely ambience and background speakeasy vibe. Fab selection of whiskeys and cocktails and a wide selection of good wines- (they do happy hours for 50% but check the times ) and non alcoholic drinks also available. Hidden away down the back of an alley nearish the Saigon centre, ( with staff outside and along the alley to guide us - it was perfectly safe anyway) we found this hidden treasure. Food menu looks excellent though we came late to the bar so did not eat. Barman has excellent English and one of the bar girls, though a little shy, soon got chatting. There is live music on Friday and Saturday early evening too! What a little jewel to find! Tad more expensive than local bars as mostly imported but the choice and quality on offer was good.

Written July 17, 2023

Excellent Cocktail Bar in hidden location at the centre of HCMC
Apr 2023 • Couples
You won’t find this bar by accident, but it is well worth looking for. They offer classic and signature cocktails expertly mixed by a friendly barman. It’s a sophisticated classic bar and plays gentle jazz rather than pop music. We enjoyed the tapas snacks which are freshly prepared to order. Apparently it used to be busy every night before COVID but now it’s quiet on weekdays especially before 8pm when they have half price happy hours. They also have a great selection of spirits from around the world.
